Exact symbolic checks of algebraic identities passed; finite tests do not substitute for analytic t>0 arguments.

originality.rationale: Lee and Kim arXiv:2608.04900 Remark 1 reduces all population sizes to a sharp variational optimization, but leaves that optimization unevaluated. The present four exact cases establish genuinely tighter attained constants than its Gamma_N bounds. Known Kearns--Saul only settles Bernoulli subcases. Searches for exact small-population constants and aliases found no coverage, subject to an unindexed-priority risk.

value.rationale: The optimal constant is a motivated invariant explicitly unresolved beyond variational form in the recent lead article. Four first nontrivial exact small-population values identify how finite-population exchangeability changes sharp weighted concentration and reveal odd-size nonlocal-tilt versus even-size variance-limit extremality. It is a meaningful finite classification even without an all-N theorem.
